description: This file contains functions for retrieving team member email information based on CRM contact data, URL query parameters, and routing form configurations within a scheduling or event management system.

methods.name: findUserByEmailWhoIsAHostOfEventType
methods.description: Finds a user who is a host of a specific event type by email.

methods.name: getRoutingFormResponseIdFromQuery
methods.description: Extracts routing form response ID or queued response ID from URL query parameters.

methods.name: getAttributeRoutingConfig
methods.description: Retrieves attribute routing configuration based on form response or route data.

methods.name: getEnabledRoutingFormAppSlugFromQuery
methods.description: Determines if a routing form app slug is present in URL query parameters.

methods.name: getOwnerEmailFromCrm
methods.description: Gets the contact owner email directly from CRM and verifies if they are a host for the event.

methods.name: getTeamMemberEmailUsingRoutingFormHandler
methods.description: Handles custom lookup logic for team member email via routing form handler.

methods.name: getTeamMemberEmailForResponseOrContact
methods.description: Main logic to determine team member email based on event data and routing form info.

methods.name: getTeamMemberEmailForResponseOrContactUsingUrlQuery
methods.description: Public function to get team member email based on URL query parameters and event data.
